notes: State Cliopatria lacks (no row). Wikipedia seems to have no article for the principality: /Kingdom_of_Raigama and /Raigama both returned the Kingdom of Gampola page, and /Raigama_Kingdom and /Raigam_Korale returned url_not_found (pages_failed). Territory comes from one sentence of the Mayadunne of Sitawaka page: 'roughly over present day Kalutara District & Southern Province except the coastline (which was under Kotte Kingdom)'. The kingdom-of-kotte (ledger 3) and kingdom-of-sitawaka (ledger 1) dossiers draw Raigama as the Kalutara district only; this dossier adds the Southern Province interior (Galle, Matara and Hambantota districts minus a 12-19 km coastal strip drawn as a polygon, a fallback) as separate events at confidence 1 and 2, so a reviewer can drop them. The rulers entry rests on the Sitawaka page ('Pararajasinha'); the Mayadunne page calls him 'Raigam Bandara'; neither page gives reign years. The capital is unverified (the dot is at Kalutara town, approximate). The principality is the 'third part of the division' of Kotte; the Portuguese relations belong to Kotte. No pages for Sitawaka's side of the 1538 annexation beyond the two sentences quoted.
